main.description:
Provision a brand-new stewarded PDS account and bring its arbiter online.

The caller authenticates via serviceAuth (aud = arbiter-server DID,
lxm = town.muni.arbiter.createArbiter). The server creates a new account
on the configured default PDS using an invite code + random password,
stores the credentials, writes the service + recovery records from the
new account's session, and loads the (default/empty) policies.

errors.name: ErrPermissionDenied
errors.description: The requesting user is not allowed to create an arbiter.

errors.name: ErrProvisioningFailed
errors.description: Account creation or initial record writes failed.
